purpose: Inherited institution-level liturgical defaults for joined ministries; never reclassify buildings or make una-cum, ecclesial or canonical claims by association.

default_assertions.basis: 2022 papal decree as published by FSSP: liturgical books in force in 1962
2022 decree explicitly includes the 1962 Roman Missal

institutions.name: Institute of Christ the King Sovereign Priest

default_assertions.basis: Institute states it celebrates the classical Roman liturgy
Institute explains its exclusive Gregorian Roman liturgical use
Institute statutes cited on official site explicitly identify 1962 liturgical books
Official Society article on the Roman liturgical books followed by the Society
Official Society article explicitly identifying the 1962 Missal

restrictions: Only exact classification source IDs and frozen site IDs are joined. Conflicts and orphans remain held.
A source-only organization label yields INHERITED_GROUP_NORM_SOURCE_LABEL, not DIRECT_CELEBRATION_VERIFIED.
A shared physical church hosting multiple institutes retains separate source/ministry relationships.
Do not infer that any venue or historical timetable has a verified 1962 Mass solely because its source has the institute label.
Never infer Una Cum, recognition of the current Roman Pontiff, canonical status, ownership, or organizer from the liturgical norm.
Dated exceptions and specific rite variations override a normative group label without rewriting the institute default.
Other institutes, diocesan and unverified categories remain UNKNOWN until their group norms are sourced.
